description: Zones exposées à l'aléa recul du trait de côte sur la côte rocheuse aquitaine en 2050 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Areas exposed to "coastal line down" hazard by 2050, juxtaposed with the Aquitaine rocky coast coastline in 2014. The latter comes from the photointerpretation of orthophotography acquired during the 2014 LiDAR survey of the IGN. The rib line position does not take protective structures into account. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Areas exposed to coastal recoil hazard on the Aquitaine rocky coast in 2050" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include recul, aléa, littoral aquitain, littoral_oca, géomorphologie, trait de côte. The listing shows 2016-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
